title: have been doing, will be doing
topic: Present perfect progressive and future progressive
canDo: Bir işin ne kadar süredir devam ettiğini ve gelecekte hangi anda süreceğini anlatabilirim.

concept.summary: Present perfect sonuca bakar, present perfect progressive sürece bakar: "üç kitap yazdım" ile "üç aydır yazıyorum" farkı. Future progressive ise gelecekte belirli bir anda sürmekte olacak işi anlatır ve İngilizcede nazik soru sormanın da yoludur.

table.example: I have been waiting for an hour.
This time tomorrow I will be flying.

examples.en: I have been studying English for six years.
She has been working here since March.
Your eyes are red. Have you been crying?
This time next week we will be sitting on a beach.
examples.tr: Gelecek hafta bu saatlerde bir sahilde oturuyor olacağız.

examples.en: He must be waiting outside.

mistakes.wrong: I am working here since March.
mistakes.right: I have been working here since March.
mistakes.why: Geçmişte başlayıp süren işte present perfect progressive gerekir.

mistakes.wrong: I have been knowing him for years.
mistakes.right: I have known him for years.

mistakes.wrong: This time tomorrow I will fly to Rome.
mistakes.right: This time tomorrow I will be flying to Rome.
mistakes.why: Belirli bir anda süren iş için will be + -ing.

exercises.text: They ___ for the bus for twenty minutes.
How long ___ you been learning Spanish?
At nine tonight I ___ the exam.
The lights are on; they ___ at home.
She ___ been feeling ill all week.
She ___ for the exam since six o'clock this morning.
This time next week we ___ on a beach.
exercises.note: Gelecekte o anda sürecek iş → will be + V-ing.

exercises.text: They ___ here for twenty minutes before the bus came.
exercises.note: Geçmişteki bir andan öncesine uzanan süre → had been + V-ing.

exercises.text: How long ___ you been working on this project?
My hands are dirty because I ___ in the garden.

title: must have, might have, should have
canDo: Geçmişte olanlar hakkında tahmin yürütebilir, pişmanlık ve eleştiri belirtebilirim.

concept.summary: Kip fiilden sonra have + V3 gelince bakış geçmişe döner. must have güçlü tahmin, might have zayıf ihtimal, should have yapılmayan ama yapılması gereken şeyi anlatır. can't have ise "olamaz" der.

table.example: He must have missed the train.

examples.en: The ground is wet; it must have rained.
She might have left already.
You should have told me earlier.
He can't have seen us in that crowd.
I shouldn't have eaten so much.

mistakes.wrong: He must had missed the train.
mistakes.right: He must have missed the train.

mistakes.wrong: You should have told me yesterday, but you did.
mistakes.right: You should have told me yesterday, but you didn't.

mistakes.wrong: She might forgot the meeting.
mistakes.right: She might have forgotten the meeting.
mistakes.why: Geçmişe bakan tahminde have + V3 gerekir.

exercises.text: The car is gone; someone ___ taken it.
I ___ studied harder for that exam.
They ___ arrived yet; it's too early.
She ___ have missed the message.
We ___ have booked earlier; now it's full.
The lights are off. They ___ home.
exercises.note: Geçmişe dair güçlü çıkarım → must have + V3.

exercises.text: You ___ told me earlier; I could have helped.
exercises.note: Yapılmayan doğru şey → should have + V3.

exercises.text: She is late. She ___ missed the train.
exercises.note: Geçmişe dair ihtimal → might have + V3.

exercises.text: He ___ have seen us; he was looking the other way.
I ___ have left my wallet in the taxi.

title: Edilgen — her zamanda
topic: Passive across tenses; passive with indirect objects
canDo: Resmî yazıda ve haber dilinde edilgen yapıyı rahatça kullanabilirim.

concept.summary: Edilgende zaman be fiilinde taşınır, asıl fiil hep üçüncü hâlde kalır. İki nesneli fiillerde (give, send, offer) iki farklı edilgen kurulabilir; İngilizce genelde kişiyi öne alanı yeğler: She was given a prize.

examples.en: The results have been published online.
All applicants will be contacted next week.
examples.tr: Tüm başvuru sahiplerine önümüzdeki hafta ulaşılacak.

examples.en: Bags are not allowed in the hall.
She was offered a new position.
examples.tr: Ona yeni bir pozisyon teklif edildi.

examples.en: We were told nothing about the delay.
examples.tr: Gecikme hakkında bize hiçbir şey söylenmedi.

mistakes.wrong: The results have published online.
mistakes.right: The results have been published online.

mistakes.wrong: She was offered to a new position.
mistakes.right: She was offered a new position.

mistakes.wrong: Bags are not allow in the hall.
mistakes.right: Bags are not allowed in the hall.

exercises.text: The bridge ___ since 2019.
You ___ by email once we decide.
Cameras ___ inside the museum.
The students ___ a certificate at the end.
The letters ___ sent yesterday.
The road ___ repaired at the moment.
exercises.note: Şu an süren edilgen → is being + V3.

exercises.text: The decision ___ already been taken.
exercises.note: Present perfect edilgen → has been + V3.

exercises.text: When we arrived, the tables ___ been laid.
exercises.note: Past perfect edilgen → had been + V3.

exercises.text: The building ___ being used when the fire started.
exercises.note: Geçmişte süren edilgen → was being + V3.

exercises.text: By next month the work ___ been completed.
exercises.note: Future perfect edilgen → will have been + V3.

title: to be done, being done, not doing
topic: Passive infinitive and gerund; negative gerund
canDo: Edilgen anlamı fiilimsi biçimlerde de kurabilirim.

concept.summary: Fiilimsiler de edilgen olabilir. to'lu biçimde to be + V3, -ing biçiminde being + V3 kullanılır. -ing'in olumsuzunda not, -ing'in önüne gelir: not knowing.

table.example: Not knowing the way, we asked.
There is work to be done.

examples.en: Nobody likes being criticised in public.
She hopes to be chosen for the team.
Not having a car, he takes the bus.
These forms need to be signed today.
He apologised for not replying sooner.
examples.tr: Daha erken cevap vermediği için özür diledi.

mistakes.wrong: She hates to being interrupted.
mistakes.right: She hates being interrupted.

mistakes.wrong: He apologised for don't replying.
mistakes.right: He apologised for not replying.

mistakes.wrong: These forms need to be sign today.
mistakes.right: These forms need to be signed today.

exercises.text: He expects ___ for the delay.

___ the answer, I said nothing.

exercises.note: Önce olmuş edilgen iş → to have been + V3.

concept.summary: İşi kendimiz yapmadığımızda, yaptıranı özne yapan bir kalıp kullanılır: nesne önce, üçüncü hâl sonra gelir. Türkçedeki ettirgen ek (-tır) burada sözdizimiyle karşılanır. Sıra bozulursa anlam tersine döner.

examples.en: I had my car serviced last week.
She is getting her kitchen painted.
We had the photos printed.
He had his phone stolen on the bus.
examples.note: İstenmeyen olay da bu kalıpla anlatılır.

examples.en: You should have your eyes tested.

mistakes.wrong: I had cut my hair yesterday.
mistakes.right: I had my hair cut yesterday.

mistakes.wrong: She is getting paint her kitchen.
mistakes.right: She is getting her kitchen painted.

mistakes.wrong: We had printed the photos by a shop.
mistakes.right: We had the photos printed at a shop.
mistakes.why: Yaptırma kalıbında nesne fiilden önce gelir.

exercises.text: You should ___ that tooth looked at.

title: as … as, not as … as, less
canDo: Eşitlik kurabilir, bir şeyin daha azını söyleyebilirim.

concept.summary: Eşitlik as … as ile kurulur ve arada sıfat yalın hâlde kalır. Olumsuzu iki türlü söylenebilir: not as tall as ya da less tall than. less uzun sıfatlarla doğal durur; kısa sıfatlarda İngilizce genelde karşıt sıfatı yeğler.

table.example: She is as tall as her brother.
It isn't as cold as yesterday.

examples.en: This phone is as good as the expensive one.
examples.tr: Bu telefon pahalı olan kadar iyi.

examples.en: The exam wasn't as hard as I expected.
Trains are less polluting than planes.
This is the least expensive room we have.
He works as hard as anyone here.

mistakes.wrong: She is as taller as her brother.
mistakes.right: She is as tall as her brother.
mistakes.why: as … as arasında sıfat yalın kalır.

mistakes.wrong: It isn't so cold than yesterday.
mistakes.right: It isn't as cold as yesterday.
mistakes.why: Eşitlik kalıbı as … as'tır, than almaz.

mistakes.wrong: This route is less crowdeder.
mistakes.right: This route is less crowded.

title: enough, so, such
canDo: Derece ve sonuç bildirerek daha etkili cümleler kurabilirim.

concept.summary: enough sıfat ve zarftan sonra, isimden önce gelir — Türkçedeki "yeterince" her iki yerde de aynı durduğu için sık karışır. so sıfat ya da zarfı, such ise isim öbeğini güçlendirir; sonuç bildirirken that'li cümlecik alırlar.

formula.right: so + sıfat / such a + sıfat + isim

table.example: He isn't old enough to drive.
It was so cold that we left.
It was such a cold day.

examples.en: The soup isn't hot enough.
There isn't enough space for everyone.
He drove so fast that I felt sick.
examples.tr: O kadar hızlı sürdü ki midem bulandı.

examples.en: It was such a long meeting that everyone got tired.
examples.tr: Öyle uzun bir toplantıydı ki herkes yoruldu.

examples.en: She was old enough to decide for herself.

mistakes.wrong: The soup isn't enough hot.
mistakes.right: The soup isn't hot enough.

mistakes.wrong: It was so a long meeting.
mistakes.right: It was such a long meeting.

mistakes.wrong: It was such cold that we left.
mistakes.right: It was so cold that we left.

title: whom, which, edat + ilgi zamiri
topic: Relative pronouns in object position; preposition + relative
canDo: Resmî yazıda doğru ilgi zamirini seçebilirim.

concept.summary: İlgi zamiri kendi cümleciğinde özne değil nesne olabilir: the man whom I met. Bu durumda günlük dilde who kullanılır ya da zamir düşürülür; whom ise resmî dilde ve özellikle edattan hemen sonra tercih edilir: the person to whom I spoke.

table.example: the room in which we met

examples.en: The colleague whom I mentioned has resigned.
The report which you sent was very useful.
This is the house in which he was born.
The candidate to whom we offered the job declined.
She is the person I trust most.

mistakes.wrong: The candidate to who we offered the job declined.
mistakes.right: The candidate to whom we offered the job declined.
mistakes.why: Edattan hemen sonra whom gelir, who değil.

mistakes.wrong: This is the house in that he was born.
mistakes.right: This is the house in which he was born.

mistakes.wrong: The report which you sent it was useful.
mistakes.right: The report which you sent was useful.
mistakes.why: İlgi zamiri zaten nesnedir, ikinci nesne konmaz.

title: whether, so that, in order to
canDo: Seçenekleri ve amacı açık biçimde ifade edebilirim.

concept.summary: whether if ile aynı işi görür ama iki seçenek varken ve edattan sonra yalnızca whether kullanılabilir. Amaç bildirirken in order to yalın fiil alır; özne değişiyorsa so that + kip fiil gerekir.

table.example: It depends on whether he agrees.
I left early in order to catch the train.
I left early so that she could rest.

examples.en: I can't decide whether to accept the offer.
examples.tr: Teklifi kabul edip etmemeye karar veremiyorum.

examples.en: It depends on whether the flight is on time.
She wrote it down in order to remember it.
I turned the light off so that he could sleep.
Let me know whether or not you are coming.

mistakes.wrong: It depends on if he agrees.
mistakes.right: It depends on whether he agrees.

mistakes.wrong: I left early so that to catch the train.
mistakes.right: I left early in order to catch the train.
mistakes.why: so that'ten sonra özneli cümlecik gelir.

mistakes.wrong: I turned the light off for he could sleep.
mistakes.right: I turned the light off so that he could sleep.
mistakes.why: Amaç cümleciği so that ile kurulur.

title: whatever, whoever, none
canDo: Koşul ne olursa olsun geçerli olan şeyleri anlatabilirim.

concept.summary: Soru kelimesine -ever eklenince "her ne olursa olsun" anlamı doğar. none ise "hiçbiri" demektir ve of ile kullanılır; no'dan farkı isimsiz kullanılabilmesidir.

examples.en: Whatever you decide, I will support you.
examples.tr: Ne karar verirsen ver, seni desteklerim.

examples.en: Whoever wrote this made a mistake.
examples.tr: Bunu kim yazdıysa bir hata yapmış.

examples.en: You can call me whenever you want.

However hard I try, it never works.
examples.tr: Ne kadar uğraşsam da hiç işe yaramıyor.

mistakes.wrong: Whatever will you decide, I will support you.
mistakes.right: Whatever you decide, I will support you.

mistakes.wrong: No of them replied.
mistakes.right: None of them replied.

mistakes.wrong: None the shops were open.
mistakes.right: None of the shops were open.
mistakes.why: none belirli bir grupla of ister.

title: Vurgu için do, kim soruları, olumsuz kipler
canDo: Söylediğimi vurgulayabilir, özneyi sorabilir, kipleri olumsuz kurabilirim.

concept.summary: Olumlu bir cümleye do eklenince vurgu doğar: I do like it. Who özneyi sorduğunda cümle düzeni bozulmaz ve do kullanılmaz — İngilizcenin tek soru istisnası budur. Kiplerin olumsuzunda not kipin hemen arkasına gelir.

examples.en: I do believe you, but the evidence is weak.
examples.tr: Sana inanıyorum gerçekten ama kanıt zayıf.

examples.en: She did tell me, I just forgot.
Who broke the window?
Who did you invite?
You don't have to explain; it isn't my business.
examples.note: Olumsuz zorunluluk ve it is not.

mistakes.wrong: Who did break the window?
mistakes.right: Who broke the window?

mistakes.right: I do believe you.
mistakes.why: do vurgusundan sonra fiil yalın kalır.

mistakes.wrong: He wouldn't to agree.
